An independently written exact polynomial checker proves the fixed sign of all 80 relevant differences on t=m-2>=0 (not a sampled guess), cross-multiplies the eight cut/cycle rational orbit formulas, proves strict optimizing-orbit phase comparisons and the deletion response including m=2 equality for P, and the common leading 1/(3m) asymptotic. A second independent grounded-Laplacian Fraction calculation checks every one of 535 actual intact and punctured projector columns for m=2,...,6, including maxima and multiplicities. Orthogonality, orientation invariance and equality of l1/linfinity endpoint norms follow from the symmetric real projector. The statement is limited to canonical Euclidean-orthogonal projections on unweighted K_{m,m,m}-e, not arbitrary projection minima or weighted graphs.

value.rationale: The canonical cut/cycle orthogonal projection endpoint norm is a natural Banach-space and graph-transportation invariant; its perturbative behavior under edge deletion is not a routine monotonicity consequence of the graph Laplacian. The theorem supplies a complete infinite dense-graph family, exact rational norms, sharp exceptional m=2 behavior, different strict maximizing-edge transitions at m=3 and m=4, and identical 1/(3m) response scales for two complementary projections. These are motivated exact geometric and operator-theoretic facts beyond one-off numerical examples. It neither claims optimal nonorthogonal projection minima nor rests on an arbitrary unmotivated finite sample.
